description:
The ask channel's CORE (RFC 0050 · Episode 2, ext4 and ext6; Episode
        3-ext1), the family's and not the grid's: one function the host gave, a
        NOTIFICATION handed over and never waited on, a QUESTION waited on
        with the person stopped — the mask session with its delay and its
        hold, the panel handle, one question at a time — and nothing else.
        What is asked and what is answered are the customers' business: the
        grid's channel keeps its selection, copy and view handover over this
        core, and the tree's keeps its fold and unfold.

        The SURFACE is what the mask needs of a presentation — openMask,
        closeMask, setMasked, openPanel, closePanel, focus — six functions a
        layout has. No DOM is touched here but through them; no payload is
        read. A crate of its own so that both presentations reach it without
        either reaching the other.
